milestone: Alpha 1.73 ordinary vendor custody and arithmetic
changes: Check stack multiplication before selling or buyback and check sale wallet addition before committing. Nonpositive legacy Value/Stack retain their existing one-Gold/single-item defaults.
Reject negative existing wallets and ambiguous selected IDs across bag and buyback without altering Gold, items, order or telemetry. No inferred data repair or historical exploit cleanup.
Serialize ordinary selling with actor-only rewards. Both sale and buyback replies read bag and buyback under the character lock before queuing messages.
Preserve normal prices, Legendary-only recovery, the twenty-item buyback history, visible bag capacity, Chronicle protection and normal per-message admission limits.

checks.reproduction: The old runtime failed ten of eleven invalid-state cases: positive/negative product overflow, sale wallet overflow, negative sale wallet, duplicate selected bag/buyback IDs and conflicting custody. A wrapped negative buyback price credited rather than charged Gold. The already-rejected negative-wallet buyback remains a regression case.
checks.fixtureCorrections: An initial fixture referenced a nonexistent Entity.Snapshot method; it now takes owned bag/buyback copies. The first server-reply stress fixture exceeded the ten-per-second admission limit; reduced its round trips to eight per message kind without bypassing or weakening production admission. World tests separately retain one hundred round trips.
checks.worldRace: Go1.27.1 go test -race ./internal/game -run '^(TestVendor|TestPerformSell|TestPerformBuyback|TestBuyback|TestDirectTrade|TestChronicle.*Item)' -count=1 -timeout=45s passed, package6.430s. Eleven rejected-state cases, two legacy/exact-boundary round trips, ordinary vendor and trade regressions, and one hundred vendor round trips concurrent with five hundred actor-only Gold rewards.
checks.dispatchRace: Go1.27.1 go test -race . -run '^TestVendor' -count=1 -timeout=45s passed, package1.563s. Normal handleMessage checks retained empty/missing/Chronicle/replay rejection; eight sale/buyback round trips returned both custody views while five hundred Gold and nested item-metadata updates ran.

limits: This is in-process vendor arithmetic/custody safety, not a crash-durable vendor acknowledgement or complete valuable-operation ledger. Single-account save barriers and two-account direct-trade recovery remain work for1.73.
No production account or wallet mutation, Mongo container, native browser run, long soak, balance change, asset edit or deployment was needed for this follow-up.
